scope: Exact standalone HTML bytes on loopback. A declared level-3 save starts uninvited/untoured. Actual Playwright pointer/key events test visible navigation, gateway, gather and workshop controls. Walk setup uses the real collision/controller path with mocked standard-pad axes and accelerated 0.05s steps; farm gateway threshold uses declared teleport immediately before actual keyboard input. Gather snapshots freeze only village controller tick, then call its original tick with explicit dt. Late story state/inventory is explicitly fixture-set, not earned in play. Viewports emulate layout/touch, not physical phone, Fold, TV, Bluetooth or GPU performance.
